text.text: Your builds in one place. Follow each Project's status, schedule subcontractor Phases, get Change orders approved before work starts, and close jobs with a tight Punch list. Operational tracking only.
A clear start prevents most disputes later.
Confirm the signed contract and deposit.
Apply for permits and note the numbers on the project.
Walk the site with the client and the superintendent.
Agree how change requests will be handled.
No work on a change until the client has approved it in writing.
Press Add change order on the project.
Get the cost from the subcontractor and add your markup.
Send for approval and set a decision date.
Mark Approved or Rejected; the Revised contract updates itself.
Review Proposed change orders and chase signatures.
Open Subcontractors, Next 30 days view, and request updated certificates
Put anyone with an expired certificate On hold
Walk the job with the client and the superintendent.
Add every item with a location and a responsible subcontractor.
Give each item a due date.
Mark Fixed when the work is done and Verified when the client agrees.
Move the project to Complete once every item is verified and final payment is in.
